dispositions.NATIVE_UNREPRESENTABLE: Versioned independent native predicate and zero payable sends required.
dispositions.STRICT_UNBOUNDED: Specific provider-enforced-bound limitation and zero payable sends; never current proxy implementation absence.
dispositions.BILLING_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP: Release blocker; safe runtime refusal does not complete the task.
dispositions.RUNTIME_PREREQUISITE_UNAVAILABLE: Release blocker; missing price, service, model evidence or test topology is not native incompatibility.

native_support_oracle: Independent locked native API/model fixtures and source-backed joint contracts, never production supports()/billing-ready flags.

required_positive_rules.rule: Every native text-capable backend/profile has successful text billing through every frontend with a natively representable text request/response.
Every natively representable finite-priced input/output mask pair is positive-required, not only pairs already implemented by the proxy.
Native image/document input pairs include mixed text+image+document positives, all relevant history/tool placements and inline/reference encodings.
Native audio profiles include audio input, audio-only output and each valid text+audio joint output; chunking and transcript inclusion are tested.
Gemini native mixed input and response modality sets receive positive fixtures, including candidate/thought/modality usage and fileData configuration preservation.
Every native image-output profile includes image-only and each native-valid mixed output set, qualified count/resolution/quality and late final usage.

Video, document and binary outputs/inputs have positive real-stack cases where the actual native operation supports them; canonical finite reference fixtures cover all six content atoms and dense mixtures independently.

Each connector runs its actual entrypoint/module codec, not just generic host transport. Inherently unbounded agents retain explicit limitations and still pass finite synthetic ABI/evidence/fence tests.
Every legal independent frontend-delivery/backend-transport and physical carrier combination expands every required-positive mask cell.

finite_scope_note: The mask product is exhaustive for this vocabulary. Arbitrary order/count/nesting and payloads need constructive properties; no certificate claims all possible bytes or future APIs.
